text: Now, to make things simple, we will actually not explain how the Wi-Fi authentication works. Why? Because nowadays it has been replaced by an authentication function implemented at the application layer. What do you do when you want to connect to an access point that is protected? Right? There is the locker icon next to it. Is to enter a username and a password. Right? That's an authentication procedure that is performed at the application layer. Okay? It's not something that is performed by Wi-Fi. This step that is possible to be performed with Wi-Fi is not actually used. What we actually use is an authentication at the application layer. Okay? So the user gets authenticated at the application layer by entering username and password. So we just keep this and say that if the user at the application layer enters a correct username and password, then at the Mac layer it is authenticated as well. Okay? So we can do the third step. And the third step is association. This is our final step before we are actually able to transmit and receive data to and from the.
